tasks_completed.description: Fence-aware extractDefinitions — def-shaped lines inside fenced code blocks are no longer stripped
tasks_completed.details: Added detectFenceOpener (renderer-consistent predicate `line.trim().startsWith('```' or '~~~')` matching tryCodeBlock @ parseMarkdownBlock.ts:207), isFenceCloser (CommonMark §4.5: same marker, run-length >= opener length, only trailing whitespace after run — info string disallowed on closer), classifyOutsideFenceLine (refactor for nesting-depth quality gate). Main extractDefinitions loop tracks fence state {marker, len}; while inside fence, lines pushed verbatim, def matchers skipped. Unclosed fences preserve all remaining lines (M4). Helpers split for quality-gate compliance (function-size + nesting-depth limits).
tasks_completed.rationale: Cycle 8 introduced extractDefinitions as a global pre-pass that walked ALL lines without fence-state tracking, so any [ref]: or [^N]: inside ``` ```` block was silently swallowed. Renderer-consistent predicate (REJ-2) ensures the def-extractor agrees with tryCodeBlock on what counts as a fence — protects tab-indented and arbitrarily-indented fences that the renderer accepts.

tasks_completed.details: Three coordinated changes: (M5) findDetailsClose now scans from lineStartIndex INCLUSIVE — opener line itself can carry the closing </details>. (M6) collectDetailsBody added same-line branch: when openIndex===endIndex, strip </details> from inlineRest and skip the multi-line closerHead push to avoid double-counting the same physical line. (M7) SUMMARY_LINE_RE relaxed from /^\s*<summary>(.*?)<\/summary>\s*$/ to /^\s*<summary>(.*?)<\/summary>\s*(.*)$/ — group 2 captures inline body remainder; extractDetailsSummary mutates bodyLines[i] when group 2 non-empty so the inline body is treated as the first body line. M8 (trailing text after </details> on same line) intentionally NOT implemented per BA spec §13 W4.
tasks_completed.rationale: Cycle 8's tryDetailsBlock found <details>/<summary>/</details> across 3 lines but failed when all three appear on a single line (the most common HTML5 form). The off-by-one fix in findDetailsClose was necessary but not sufficient — codex round-2 in BA-spec uncovered the cascading body/summary mishandling.

tasks_completed.description: Sub vs sup baseline shift via translateY ±4, fontSize 10, lineHeight 14
tasks_completed.details: Lines 527-528: sub: { fontSize: 10, lineHeight: 14, transform: [{ translateY: 4 }] }, sup: { fontSize: 10, lineHeight: 14, transform: [{ translateY: -4 }] }. Was: { fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 16 } — byte-identical. Hardcoded 10px (not relative em) per BA spec W3 (codex round-2 directive: hardcoded 10 keeps within 0.75em of the 16px base text style without scope expansion).
tasks_completed.rationale: Cycle 8 shipped the sub/sup HTML tokenizer and parser support but the style entries were byte-identical, so semantic distinction was lost at render time. This was caught by codex round-1 against Cycle 8's close-debate.

tasks_completed.description: i18n footnote modal title — `Footnote ${label}` replaced with t('markdown.footnoteTitle', {label}) and key added to all 11 translation files
tasks_completed.details: MarkdownInlineDecorations.tsx:42 modal title now uses t('markdown.footnoteTitle', { label: props.span.footnoteLabel }). Each of the 11 translation source files (10 langs + _default.ts) gained `footnoteTitle: ({ label }: { label: string }) => '...'` under the existing `markdown` object. Translations: en `Footnote ${label}`, ru `Сноска ${label}`, pl `Przypis ${label}`, es/ca/it/pt `Nota ${label}`, ja `脚注 ${label}`, zh-Hans `脚注 ${label}`, zh-Hant `註腳 ${label}`.
tasks_completed.rationale: Per packages/happy-app/CLAUDE.md i18n section: 'Never hardcode strings in JSX — always use t(key)'. Cycle 8 introduced the modal title as a literal English template — i18n violation. Label is safe for direct interpolation (FOOTNOTE_DEF_RE group 1 = [^\]\s]+ excludes special chars).

implementation_summary.CR-1: extractDefinitions is now fence-aware with marker char + run-length tracking. Renderer-consistent predicate (`line.trim().startsWith('```' or '~~~')`) closes the iter-2 REJ-2 tab-indented-fence regression vector. Closer rules per CommonMark §4.5: same marker char, run length >= opener length, only trailing whitespace after run (info string on closer disallowed). Unclosed fences preserve all remaining lines from open to EOF (REJ-3). Refactored into 3 helper functions (detectFenceOpener / isFenceCloser / classifyOutsideFenceLine + resolveFootnoteDefs) to satisfy quality-gate function-size + nesting-depth caps.
implementation_summary.CR-2: Three coordinated edits to handle compact <details><summary>X</summary>Y</details> single-line form. M5 changes findDetailsClose call site to start at lineStartIndex INCLUSIVE; M6 adds same-line collectDetailsBody branch with </details> stripping; M7 relaxes SUMMARY_LINE_RE to capture inline body remainder. M8 trailing-text-after-</details> intentionally out-of-scope per BA spec.
implementation_summary.CR-3: sub/sup styles in MarkdownView.tsx now distinct: translateY +4 vs -4, fontSize 10 (down from 12), lineHeight 14 (down from 16). Hardcoded 10px not relative em per BA W3.
implementation_summary.CR-4: Modal title delegated to t('markdown.footnoteTitle', {label}); key added to all 11 translation source files (10 langs + _default.ts). Localized prefixes per spec §9.4 guidance — Sino+Korean langs use 脚注/註腳/Сноска/Przypis/Nota etc.
